inputs.label: WWF No Mercy ROM (North America, Rev 1 / Rev A)
inputs.help: Your own North American (USA) Rev 1 / Rev A ROM of WWF No Mercy as .z64, .n64 or .v64.

steps.text: Open WWF No Mercy VR from Library > Unknown Sources. In the main menu, provide your ROM. The game loads its assets from it.

notes: The repository has a single release with the fixed tag n64, apparently updated in place; the payload version (v0.1.20) does not appear in the tag or asset name, so qgp cannot tell versions apart from GitHub.
